hooks.command: echo 'RESPONSE STANDARD (github-workflow): every reply you write to the user follows the user-facing-communication skill, whether or not a workflow command is running. Open with what was done and the current state, and be exact about that state: implemented, committed, pushed, pull request opened, reviewed, merged and deployed are different things. Put anything outstanding, blocked or assumed where it cannot be missed. Name every issue and pull request by number AND title, never a bare number. Leave out investigation history, file lists and test names. Full standard: skills/user-facing-communication/SKILL.md.'

echo 'WARNING: Off-workflow issue creation. Prefer /github-workflow:report-issue, which validates the body (--body-file), creates and verifies labels, attaches the current milestone, and handles Windows shell-escaping. If you are already inside the report-issue or execute skill, proceed.'

echo 'WARNING: Off-workflow PR creation. Prefer /github-workflow:execute, which validates the body (--body-file), applies and verifies the claude-authored label, releases the atomic claim, and moves the board to In Review. If you are already inside the execute skill, proceed.'
